explication: AWS SDK for Swift lets application code configure a service client, invoke a typed AWS operation, and receive a typed response or service error. Generated service clients construct operation orchestrators; the runtime supplies configuration, endpoint resolution, authentication, request middleware, retries, and AWS-specific error handling. Identity resolution and signing support the request path, while checksums and event-stream signing cover specialized protocols. The README documents these runtime modules and the tree shows many generated service clients. Excerpts are partial, so links among unsampled subsystems are not expanded.
